work_item.role: W1 public-evidence discovery and neutral admission

collection_state.note: Pass 31 remains an independently occupied branch and is not modified or treated as completed by this handoff.

discovery_pass.method: Direction-blind admission of three source-reported held-out Legal Agent Benchmark harness observations from an immutable study revision. W1 preserves the fixed model route, judge, one-rollout test protocol, dev-only harness development boundary, retry policy, host-mode execution, and public-artifact caveats without selecting a preferred harness or inferring a mechanism effect.

source_known_dimensions: same source retry policy for transient provider failures
harness development and selection performed on dev rather than held-out test
explicit_unknown_or_nonidentical_dimensi: exact service-side model checkpoint behind the provider route
provider-side load and routing state across rollouts
public result bucket paths are mutable even though aggregate values and harness code are pinned by the immutable GitHub revision
the three harness variants intentionally differ in prompting, loop guards, output handling and other harness behavior

provenance_strength.w1_treatment: admit the three factual held-out aggregates because the study README and harness implementations are immutable at the pinned GitHub revision; retain the mutable result-bucket limitation explicitly

protocol_deviations_and_failures.detail: The Hugging Face bucket exposes public run artifacts but W1 does not have a bucket-wide immutable revision identifier. The source-reported aggregate values admitted here are independently frozen in the pinned GitHub README.
The held-out test uses one rollout per task. The source separately reports a smaller dev variance study; W1 does not convert it into uncertainty for these test aggregates.

Workflow run 36722490370 (run 341) failed before any job steps executed. No evidence admission or repository validation command ran in that attempt. The temporary workflow was aligned to the immediately preceding proven pass-35 control pattern before retry.

The synchronize event emitted by the github-actions bot registry commit produced workflow run 36722708825 (run 343) with conclusion action_required. It is not used as validation evidence; human-authored restored-standard-workflow run 344 is the post-generation control check.

non_admission_dispositions.reason: The relevant GLM-5.2 harness-by-model observations are already present from pass 27 after the publisher's binding task quarantine; W1 does not duplicate the same executed evidence under a second release label.

non_admission_dispositions.surface: Coding Agent Bench GLM-5.2 250-task main-grid aggregate
non_admission_dispositions.reason: The primary research log states the published aggregate mixed 16k and 32k output-cap eras and that several harnesses were never measured under the later cap. W1 does not normalize or reinterpret that mixed execution surface.

The publisher later removed the Aider showcase from canonical published benchmark results while retaining source/community material. W1 preserves the withdrawal instead of promoting the retained copy as a current benchmark result.

results.detail: Neutral registry regeneration, repository validation, post-closure validators, the pass-36 record-specific admission check, and the existing live admission loop all succeeded.
Standard read-only validation workflow passed after the temporary generation/admission hook was removed.
